entities.description: Weatherlight navigator who protects the Legacy.

entities.description: Cat warrior of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem carried to the Predator by moggs.

entities.description: Samite healer aboard the Weatherlight.

entities.description: Minotaur of the Weatherlight who fights Greven.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin cabin hand.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard adept who opens the portal.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Man haunted by Selenia's betrayal and the dead.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Dark angel who leads the Predator to the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Tyrant of Rath who scorns the living and drives Greven.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Subordinate of Greven who is lifted off his feet.

entities.name: Starke

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: Soltari emissary.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: Vec oracle who glances suspiciously at Starke.

entities.name: Tahli en-Dal
entities.description: Bounty hunter on pegasi.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Volrath's ship carrying moggs and Greven.

entities.name: Thalakos
entities.description: Beings caught between the Soltari and the Dauthi.

entities.description: Forest of Rath where elves live.

entities.name: Glok

events.summary: Hanna and Mirri face slivers that protect each other.
events.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

events.summary: The swarm ignores the destruction of the artificial slivers.
events.quote: They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed.

events.summary: Mirri apologizes to Hanna for thinking her a burden.
events.quote: I thought you a burden, and you saved my life.

events.summary: Gerrard draws his sword and tells his crew the enemy should have brought a second ship.
events.quote: They should have brought a second ship!

events.summary: Karn, frozen by conscience, does not resist as moggs carry him to the Predator.
events.quote: Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the *Predator*.

events.summary: Greven mocks Vhati's aim and judgment after a cannon misfire.
events.quote: your judgment or your aim.

events.summary: Ertai begins meditating at the portal and realizes he is not alone.
events.quote: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation.

events.summary: Gerrard orders slivers kept at sword's length, but their talons grow longer.
events.quote: Keep them at sword's length!

events.summary: Squee swaps a pebble for a warm ball and hides, murmuring Glok.
events.quote: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place.

events.summary: Volrath tells Karn he has failed Gerrard and the Legacy.
events.quote: You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy.

events.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he must work hard yet appear effortless like the drake.
events.quote: You *must* do the same.

events.summary: Gerrard vanishes into the maw of trees as Hanna mourns.
events.quote: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees

events.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits.
events.quote: it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

events.summary: Greven lifts Vhati off his feet and punishes his failure with a fall.
events.quote: The fall will give you time to think on your failure.

events.summary: Crovax sees a banquet in the dead.
events.quote: for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

events.summary: Volrath vows to bind Crovax with pain.
events.quote: I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream.

events.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
events.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

events.summary: Volrath berates Greven for failing to capture Gerrard.
events.quote: Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard

events.summary: Ertai volunteers to open the portal.
events.quote: Ertai volunteered to open the portal.

events.summary: Barbed slivers form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
events.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

events.summary: Tahngarth easily bests Greven.
events.quote: The match between Tahngarth and Greven was close only in the mind of the minotaur.

events.summary: Orim places a lightning rod on the bow and the Furnace turns on her.
events.quote: That's when the Furnace got personal.

events.summary: Gerrard and Greven approach each other while moggs flee.
events.quote: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other

events.summary: Starke decides the Oracle glanced at him once too often.
events.quote: Starke decided she had glanced twice too often.

events.summary: The Predator lists the Weatherlight and Hanna screams.
events.quote: the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed.

events.summary: Eladamri's mushroom wine makes Gerrard sick.
events.quote: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin

events.summary: Eladamri declares his people ready to attack now.
events.quote: We have been patient. We have planned our attack.

events.summary: Gerrard escapes as a wurm eats merfolk.
events.quote: As Gerrard made his escape

events.summary: Volrath warns Greven about free will.
events.quote: Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven

events.summary: Squee clutches his toy as horrors close in on Gerrard.
events.quote: Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort.

events.summary: Greven forbids moggs from operating telethopters.
events.quote: Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

events.summary: A counterfeit accepted by the sliver hive increases Volrath's influence.
events.quote: Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

relations.note: Greven calls Volrath a harsh master.
Soltari chant to carry war to the Dauthi.
